# Spirit Naga (`monsters:spirit-naga`)
*Large fiend, chaotic evil* | **CR** 8 (XP 3,900; PB +3)
**AC** 17 | **HP** 135 (18d10 + 36) | **Speed** 40 ft.
**STR** 18 (+4) | **DEX** 17 (+3) | **CON** 14 (+2) | **INT** 16 (+3) | **WIS** 15 (+2) | **CHA** 16 (+3)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +6, [Saving Throw: CON](../proficiencies/saving-throw-con.md) +5, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +5, [Saving Throw: CHA](../proficiencies/saving-throw-cha.md) +6
**Damage Immunities:** poison
**Condition Immunities:** [Charmed](../conditions/charmed.md), [Poisoned](../conditions/poisoned.md)
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 12
**Languages:** Abyssal, Common

## Traits
- **Fiendish Restoration.** If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.
- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.
- **Necrotic Ray.** Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.
- **Spellcasting.** The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
  - At will: [Detect Magic](../spells/detect-magic.md) (level 1), [Mage Hand](../spells/mage-hand.md), [Minor Illusion](../spells/minor-illusion.md), [Water Breathing](../spells/water-breathing.md) (level 3)
  - 2/day: [Detect Thoughts](../spells/detect-thoughts.md) (level 2), [Dimension Door](../spells/dimension-door.md) (level 4), [Hold Person](../spells/hold-person.md) (level 3), [Lightning Bolt](../spells/lightning-bolt.md) (level 4)
